inputs.prompt: Edit this drone image. Change only the nose: add a compact gimbal camera tucked underneath the front of the fuselage, as on modern foldable camera drones. Seen from directly above, only the smooth matte grey top cover of the camera housing and its two short side arms show just ahead of the nose. The lens points straight forward toward the top edge of the image and is completely hidden in this overhead view: no lens, glass, window or dark circle is visible on the top of the camera. Keep everything else exactly the same: the strict orthographic top view, the body outline, the top cover panels and parting lines, the seamless arms, the motors with their orange rings, the two-blade propellers and their angles, the colours and the plain light background.
inputs.negative_prompt: flat schematic, line drawing, collage, text, labels, logo, cropped rotor, disconnected arm, extra rotor, perspective camera, camera lens visible from above, upward-facing lens, camera on a neck or stalk, camera on a post, camera at the tail, dark module at the tail, V-shaped propeller, blades at an acute angle, single-blade propeller, missing blade, unequal blades, lens glass on the top of the camera, camera window on top, dark circle on the camera top
